name: dfirswarm
description: DFIR Swarm: an agent swarm for digital forensics and incident response. Local, observable peer agents on Herdr + Pi: a sanctioned file board, enforced write leases, read-only evidence guarded at the kernel, a shared ledger, a harness-owned stop sentinel, spend, token and wall-clock caps, an egress allowlist and a live local web console.
author: Halil Öztürkci
